title: Interactive pH Scale
guideExplore: Tap a substance, drag Custom pH, or press a scenario button to see how pH changes.
guideAcidic: Acidic! Below pH 7 the scale glows red-orange — acids taste sour and react with metals.
guideNeutral: Neutral! pH 7 sits exactly in the middle, like pure water.
guideBasic: Basic (alkaline)! Above pH 7 the scale glows blue-purple — bases feel slippery.
guideTourComplete: Great tour! You checked a strong acid, a neutral, and a strong base.
learnMore: Tip: pH below 7 is acidic, 7 is neutral, above 7 is basic — each whole step is a 10× change in strength!
leftTip: Colors follow the real pH indicator scale: red for strong acids, green near neutral, purple for strong bases.
